decision_rule: go iff encodable/sample_size >= 0.3 (Phase 3 admits only encodable pairs; no-go blocks scaling that corpus)

manifest.selection_rationale: Chose gitleaks (RE2) over detect-secrets because Phase 1 already ships the Go regexp/syntax helper + rule-file extractor; RE2 fold divergence (İ/ı) and rule-corpus scale are the hardest dialect probes before Phase 3 rule_diff. Leading (?i) flags are lifted into flags=i for compile; \b remains unencodable.
manifest.notes: Phase 3 admits only encodable pairs from this report. Decision=no-go means do not scale the full corpus; the encodable subset may still pilot shape-5.
